notes: Integrity scan was clean. Literature check (strict, cutoff 2025-09-24) ran 6 searches; arXiv keyword search returned many off-topic hits for statistical queries, so the 'stability selection' gap was filled from knowledge with [verify]. The script's novelty verdict ('high') rests on thin arXiv-only results and was tempered to medium by the Domain reviewer; the skill does not say how to reconcile the two. The skill's rule that reviewers must give a pool position while the script prints the pool 'band' as a score range is slightly confusing (DA pool 38 shown with band 42-54). The skill asks EIC to start weights at 1.0 and move them only for verified reasons; simulating all five roles in one context makes 'verified reviewer errors' partly self-generated, so the R3 down-weight rests on a deliberately modest overstatement. The R1 'identical metric values' observation sits between suspicion (Questions) and verified error (Weaknesses); I put it in Weaknesses as an observation with an open interpretation. Figures were not viewable, so figure-based claims (noise axis range, multimodality) are from extracted text and captions. run.json in the results directory was an empty file created before my work and was left untouched.
